image_description: A vintage blue typewriter viewed from a high angle. The image features a full keyboard with round, white keys bearing black characters. A long, rectangular key (the space bar) is located at the bottom center of the keyboard. A sheet of paper is loaded into the carriage, and a blue document holder is attached to the left side.
